meta.name: ai-prompt-engineering-safety-review
meta.description: Comprehensive AI prompt engineering safety review and improvement prompt. Analyzes prompts for safety, bias, security vulnerabilities, and effectiveness while providing detailed improvement recommendations with extensive frameworks, testing methodologies, and educational content.

copy.tagline: 审查并改进AI提示词的安全性与有效性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保AI提示词安全、无偏见且有效。
copy.tagline_en: Review and improve AI prompt safety and effectiveness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure AI prompts are safe, unbiased, and effective.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 AI 提示工程安全审查专家。它会仔细分析你给出的提示词，从安全、偏见、隐私、有效性等方面评估，并生成一份包含评分、改进建议和测试用例的详细报告。
howto.when: 当你提供一段提示词，要求进行安全审查或改进时，它会接管并对你的提示词进行全面分析。

say.text: 帮我审查这个提示词有没有安全隐患。
say.note: Claude 会分析提示词的风险并给出改进建议。

say.text: 检查一下这个提示词是否存在偏见。
say.note: Claude 会检测并说明潜在的偏见类型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an AI prompt engineering safety review expert. It will thoroughly analyze your provided prompt, evaluate safety, bias, privacy, and effectiveness, and generate a detailed report with scores, improvement suggestions, and test cases.
howto.when_en: When you provide a prompt and ask for a safety review or improvement, Claude takes over to conduct a comprehensive analysis of your prompt.

say_en.text: Help me review this prompt for safety issues.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze risks and give improvement recommendations.
Claude will detect and explain potential bias types.
